entries.전술, 리듬 액션, 친밀도 성장이 하나로 이어지는 판타지 RPG: A fantasy RPG that weaves together tactics, rhythm action, and growing bonds
entries.신의 부름을 받은 주인공은 아르데라 대륙을 여행하며 4인 파티를 편성하고: Called by the gods, the hero travels the continent of Ardera, forms a four-member party, and layers skill timing and ultimate inputs on top of auto-battles to face the threat of the Demon Lord Nemesis.
Build today's party around roles and Stamina.
Skills and ultimates get stronger with on-beat inputs.
Gifts, conversations, and events feed into combat growth.
entries.기본 전투는 자동으로 흐르지만, 중요한 순간의 스킬 타이밍과 궁극기 발동: Basic combat runs automatically, but you decide skill timing and when to unleash ultimates at key moments.
entries.아침, 낮, 저녁, 밤의 행동 선택이 탐험, 상점, 이벤트, 성장 계획에: What you do in the morning, afternoon, evening, and night shapes your exploration, shopping, events, and growth plans.
entries.전투 보상으로 장비 강화, 장비 초월, 룬 세팅, 룬 합성을 이어가며 파: Use battle rewards to upgrade and transcend gear, set runes, and fuse runes to strengthen your party.
entries.캐릭터와의 관계가 깊어질수록 대화, 전용 이벤트, 전투 보너스, 의상 콘: As your bond with a character deepens, you unlock conversations, exclusive events, combat bonuses, and outfits.
entries.하루 단위로 반복되는 탐험과 성장: A daily cycle of exploration and growth
entries.Project H의 핵심은 로비에서 준비하고, 탐험으로 전투를 진행한 뒤: At its core, Project H has you prepare in the lobby, fight through expeditions, and use the rewards to open up more options for the next day.
entries.스킬 생성 → 스킬 사용 → 궁극기 게이지 충전 → 궁극기 발동으로 이어: Generate skills → Use skills → Charge the ultimate gauge → Unleash your ultimate.
entries.골드와 재화를 사용해 장비 강화, 룬 세팅, 친밀도 이벤트, 스탯 강화를: Spend Gold and resources on gear upgrades, rune setups, affinity events, and stat boosts.
entries.하루는 시간 슬롯과 활력 관리로 진행되며, 100일 안에 마왕 토벌을 목: Each day runs on time slots and Stamina management, with the goal of defeating the Demon Lord within 100 days.
entries.각 동료를 한 명씩 넘겨 보며 이미지 영역과 캐릭터 설명을 확인하는 파트: Flip through your companions one by one to see each character's artwork and profile.
entries.여신의 계시로 주인공을 처음 맞이한 성녀이며, 치유와 정화 능력으로 파티: The Saint who first welcomed the hero at the Goddess's revelation, she keeps the party alive with healing and purification.
entries.장비, 룬, 골드, 활력, 친밀도 아이템은 전투력과 일정 관리에 직접 연: Gear, runes, Gold, Stamina, and affinity items tie directly into combat power and schedule management.
entries.여신의 축복이 흔들리는 대륙: A continent where the Goddess's blessing falters

The human kingdom where your journey with the Saint Serena begins.
A city of magic, home to the Mage Tower and its sorcerers.
A forest where traces of elves and spirits remain.
A military nation of knights and soldiers.
Home to the remains of a long-lost civilization and perilous places to explore.

entries.마법도시 노아르의 천재 마법사이며, 범위 마법과 디버프를 활용해 전장을: A prodigy mage from the magic city of Noir, she controls the battlefield with area spells and debuffs.

entries.실바란 숲의 정령궁수이며, 연속 사격과 치명타 중심의 중거리 지속 화력을: A spirit archer of the Silvaran Forest, she provides sustained mid-range firepower through rapid shots and critical hits.
entries.기계도시 메리디안 출신 연금술사이며, 버프와 디버프와 회복을 함께 다루는: An alchemist from the machine city of Meridian, she is an all-rounder who handles buffs, debuffs, and healing.
entries.길드연합의 용병 출신 총사수이며, 관통 사격과 고정 치명타 공격으로 핵심: A former Guild Alliance mercenary turned gunner, she eliminates key targets with piercing shots and guaranteed critical hits.
entries.카르니안 제국의 창기사이며, 폭발적인 돌진기와 화상 피해로 적진을 흔드는: A lance knight of the Carnian Empire, she is a breaker who shatters enemy lines with explosive charges and burn damage.
entries.제국 남부 수호대 출신 방패병이며, 보호막과 반격으로 약한 아군을 지키는: A shieldbearer from the Empire's Southern Guard, she is an off-tank who protects weaker allies with shields and counterattacks.
entries.동방 사원의 젊은 수행자이며, 정령 소환과 근접 공격을 겸해 순간 폭딜과: A young ascetic from an eastern temple, she combines spirit summons with melee attacks to deliver burst damage and binds.
entries.길드연합의 자유로운 모험가이며, 함정과 이동속도 디버프와 약점 노출로 전: A free-spirited adventurer of the Guild Alliance, she turns the tide of battle with traps, slows, and exposed weaknesses.
entries.신의 사도단 엘리트 순례자이며, 공격과 회복과 부활을 함께 지닌 하이브리: An elite pilgrim of the Apostles of God, she is a hybrid battle cleric who can attack, heal, and revive.
